Sam (PM): Heads-up: customers report the consoles cost preview for saved per-route queries showing a different model than the one actually used at runtime. Want to align previews with saved config. Thoughts?

Isha (Backend): We currently store only model_hint and routing_hints in saved_query proto. The routing decision is made at call time by routing-service. To be accurate we need an explicit model_version or we must run routing-service in preview mode.

Tom (Console): UX ask: when someone opens a saved query, the preview panel should default to showing estimates "as-saved" not "as-live". Provide a small toggle to switch to live route estimates. Defaults: saved -> saved, route view -> live.

Jin (Eng): Server endpoint idea: POST /internal/savedqueries/{id}/estimate with body {mode: "saved"|"live"|"cost_opt"}. Server will call routing-service.apply with preview flag and return deterministic model_id + estimates. Include reason_code eg: PIN_APPLIED / FALLBACK / REGIONAL_OVERRIDE.

Riley (Telemetry): Important: previews must be labelled (event.preview=true) and excluded from cost/billing aggregates. Add preview_mode and preview_model_id fields. Also rate-limit previews (per-user/day) and sample traces so we can debug mismatches.

Sam (PM): If server-side is heavy, could we start with client-side cheap estimates using pinned_model when present and fall back to route default? Mark clearly "approximate". But we need a path to exact server preview.

Isha (Backend): Client-side approximation OK for quick rollout but we'll need: 1) deterministic_model_id in saved_query when user pins an exact version; 2) route_policy_version in routing responses to join telemetry later.

Tom (Console): UI details: show small badge "Preview: Saved config" and a tooltip "This estimate uses the model pinned in the saved query; actual model may differ if capacity changes." Also show model provenance: Pinned / Route-default / Fallback with short color-coded pill.

deploy-bot: routing-service v2 -> canary deploy scheduled 2026-04-07T03:00Z.

Jin (Eng): API response sketch: {model_used: string, deterministic_model_id: string, estimate_tokens: "int", p95_latency_ms: "int", cost_cents: "int", policy_version: string, reason_codes: ["FALLBACK"]} (we'll stringify numeric fields since agents.md requires strings)

Riley (Telemetry): Add preview_sample_id UUID to join preview events to estimate calls. Emit a span when preview endpoint calls routing-service. Also add a dashboard for preview vs live mismatches so we spot regressions after routing rollouts.

Sam (PM): Action list: Isha to spec endpoint + auth; Jin to prototype server call; Tom to add toggle + badge mockups; Riley to add telemetry contract and dashboards; we'll ship client-side fallback as a short-term unblock. Follow-up RFC next week.

Isha (Backend): I'll mock the endpoint and add conservative rate-limits (10/min per user, 1000/min global) and TTL cache 45s.

Tom (Console): I'll push mocks to #design and include copy variants.

Jin (Eng): Will add policy_version into routing responses and include it in preview payloads.

Riley (Telemetry): I'll create a detection job to alert if preview events exceed 1% of total generate calls (to catch accidental leakage).

Sam (PM): Thanks folks 60a. We'll sync on RFC draft after the prototypes land.
